section: 7/1/2014Amended by Chapter 54, 2014 General Session2014Commission authority related to the Multistate Tax Commission and governmental entities.The commission may furnish to the Multistate Tax Commission, a taxing official of another state, the District of Columbia, or the United States or its territories, any information contained in: a tax return or report, a related schedule, or a document filed pursuant to the tax laws of this state; or the report of an audit or investigation made with respect to a tax return or report, a related schedule, or a document described in Subsection (1).
